name: ae-sdd-monitor
description: Desktop workspace monitor for ae-sdd runtime state.
author: ae-sdd

scripts.test:renderer: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer
scripts.pack:dir: npm run build:renderer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-win.ps1 -NoArchive
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:renderer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-win.ps1
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:unsigned: npm run build:renderer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-mac-unsigned.ps1
scripts.dist: npm run build:renderer && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-win.ps1
scripts.dist:builder: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis zip
scripts.dist:builder:all: npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --win nsis zip --mac dmg zip
